notes: Build84 browser-test refinement after real-user homologation. The validated GitHub/Supabase resource checkpoint remains preserved. The old Editor Direct placeholder UI is no longer shipped: ux-polish creates the parity control, then editor-direct-authority-v84 converts it into the unique functional Editor Direct action before user interaction. GitHub Sync/history remains read-only and fail-closed on explicit project binding. Resource management retries one transient DB/config read error exactly once with no timer or polling. Supabase Project Manager v2 preserves test/bind/create behavior, adds clickable project detail/provisioning, manual status refresh, guarded project rename through an isolated custom-auth backend, and test-state red pulse/success green check UX. Gemini remains optional/local-AI-secondary; Free Only remains default, while paid or unverified models are exposed only behind explicit user opt-in and are labeled potentially billable; no prompt is generated for connection validation. No MutationObserver, continuous polling, shell inert takeover, mount guardian, network monkeypatch or heavy provider activation at boot is shipped.
